metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.1 · 2012 · Pitch Perfect
metas.description: Beca, a freshman at Barden University, is cajoled into joining The Bellas, her school's all-girls singing group. Injecting some much needed energy into their repertoire, The Bellas take on their male rivals in a campus competition.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.4 · 2015 · Pitch Perfect 2
metas.description: After a humiliating command performance at The Kennedy Center, the Barden Bellas enter an international competition that no American group has ever won in order to regain their status and right to perform.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 5.8 · 2017 · Pitch Perfect 3
metas.description: Following their win at the world championship, the now separated Bellas reunite for one last singing competition at an overseas USO tour, but face a group who uses both instruments and voices.
